image_set.subset: first 2048 test images in loader order (whole batches of 256 until max_images=2000 is reached)

definitions.iterations: routing iteration index; the largest key is the final iteration, whose gate weights the output
definitions.logG: -beta_i * H_in in float64, H recomputed from coupling_coeffs with eps=1e-08
definitions.variance: population (ddof=0) on the balanced capsule x image grid; total = between_capsule + within_capsule; within_capsule = image_main + interaction
definitions.share_of_summed_within_capsule_var_logG: sum over the role's capsules of Var_images(log G) / the same sum over all capsules
definitions.per_capsule: quantiles over the role's capsules of each capsule's across-image SD (ddof=0) or CV = SD / mean
definitions.roles: native to each model's own hub taxonomy; not matched across models

random_seed.note: No RNG: inference only on frozen checkpoints in eval mode over an unshuffled test loader, with library defaults left untouched as in experiments/role_intervention.py.

_provenance.statistical_method: Inference-only on frozen VEG checkpoints. Per-image coupling entropy H and log gate -beta*H at the last two routing iterations; exact ddof=0 split of the variance of log G, G and H on the balanced capsule x image grid into between-capsule, image main effect and capsule x image interaction, overall and within each native role, plus quantiles of per-capsule SD and CV. Descriptive only: no hypothesis test and no interval.
